source: Copied from the first local design exploration; original generated pixels preserved.
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: a high-fidelity desktop homepage design exploration for the Ferramenta family of Rust developer tools.
Primary request: Generate ONE complete, polished, realistic website screenshot, not a moodboard. Portrait canvas approximately 1440 wide by 1960 tall, representing a desktop browser width, all sections large and readable, from site header down to a compact footer. No browser chrome, no laptop mockup, no external concept title or numbered board.
Art direction: light theme ONLY, including header, footer and all code panels. Warm, precise, durable, carefully engineered German industrial design qualities expressed through proportion, restraint and details. Lightweight mechanical craft, fine tolerances, not heavy industry. Use warm white and light neutral surfaces, natural pale wood and finely brushed silver metal very selectively. Text mostly on plain light surfaces. Excellent contrast and generous spacing. Restrained regular or medium typography, sentence case headings, no oversized heavy condensed capitals. Material should look authentic but never turn the whole UI into a physical prop.
Product truth: Ferramenta is a family of independent Rust engines. Ferromark is a Markdown renderer for Rust and Node.js: Markdown to HTML plus front matter, heading IDs, footnotes, CommonMark and GFM; Rust and Node have distinct documented trust defaults, so do not claim all output is sanitized by default. Ferroni is Oniguruma's regex engine in memory-safe Rust, supporting lookbehind, backreferences, recursion, Unicode and the TextMate multi-pattern scanner. Ferriki runs on Ferroni; Ferromark pairs with Ferriki. Never portray all family members as a dependency pipeline.
Constraints: all visible interface copy in accurate US English. Realistic helpful content, concise copy, no lorem ipsum, no invented customer logos, testimonials, awards, download statistics, fabricated benchmark numbers, certifications, flags, or claims of origin. Small unobtrusive Ferramenta family link in the header and quiet family links near the footer. No dark sections, dark code editors, black slabs, massive gears, anvils, heavy bolts or riveted steel plates, rusty/grunge textures, distressed wood, steampunk, industrial violence, oversized badges, shiny chrome, orange gradients or generic card grids. No theme switcher. Compose a usable developer homepage, with real navigation, product explanation, code or output, proof links and an entry action.


## 04. White drawing board — Ferroni

Final file: 04-white-drawing-board-ferroni-v2.png

A central orthographic mechanism with surrounding product explanations and a clean lower specification band.

### Initial prompt extension

Composition: an off-center technical drawing board on a near-white background. Slim top header, title and short definition at upper left, main actions upper right. The middle of the first screen is one large delicate orthographic diagram of a compact regex mechanism: hairline aluminum paths, three small ceramic-and-metal modules labeled "Pattern", "Compile", "Match" on a barely visible drawing grid, with one pale oak crosspiece visible under the assembly. This illustrates only internal work of the Ferroni engine, never the family as a chain. Short prose callouts sit in open whitespace around it like precise annotations, with sparse leaders, not boxed cards. Below a broad white band shows a real regex example; then two unequal columns "Compatibility" and "Scanner" and a tiny light footer. No large 3D hero photo.
Palette: warm white #FCFCF9, drawing gray #D5DAD5, aluminum #BEC6C4, oak #D8C19C, graphite #384340, muted blue #597984.
Type: technical sans of regular width, moderate scale and weight, mono annotation values.
Text verbatim: "Ferroni"; "A regex engine, carefully continued."; "Oniguruma syntax in memory-safe Rust."; "Get started"; "Documentation"; "Pattern"; "Compile"; "Match"; "Lookbehind and backreferences"; "The TextMate scanner, built in."; "Compatibility"; "Inspect the checks"; "cargo add ferroni".

### Final refinement prompt

Edit this existing Ferroni website screenshot. Preserve the light page, header, headline, action group, all section positions and overall desktop page layout. Replace ONLY the central complex physical machine illustration with an exceptionally spare TWO-DIMENSIONAL engineering drawing on white: three very thin outlined rectangular layers, a few straight fine lines, delicate alignment ticks and a simple open steel spring curve. Labels "Pattern", "Compile", "Match", with the same two small prose callouts around the drawing. Use graphite and muted blue hairlines with one very faint pale wood grain strip below the drawing. The diagram must feel like an optician's precision drawing, not a factory: absolutely no gears, pipes, tubes, bolts, boxes, mechanisms, 3D rendering or machinery. It should contain at least 80% empty white area. Also simplify the lower code examples into a plain regex specimen: pattern "(?<=item-)\d+", text "item-104   item-208", matches "104" and "208"; install code "cargo add ferroni". Remove invented API examples and Node.js usage wording. Retain "Compatibility", "Scanner" and "Inspect the checks" content. Keep the typography clean and light.
